groups.defect: Guest filtering permits case-based blacklist bypasses, case-variant duplicates of existing attendees, and duplicate emails within the submitted list.
groups.rationale: All four report the blacklist normalization defect; overlapping members additionally report missing attendee normalization and input deduplication. The appended email-dispatch and authorization changes appear only as proposed fixes, so they do not link this group to other defects.

groups.defect: Email dispatch uses raw guests instead of filtered uniqueGuests, and an unhandled calendar-update failure after persistence leaves guests saved despite the request failing.
groups.rationale: s_c03cd3b4 explicitly reports both defects, connecting the email-classification finding in s_d430022b with the persistence/calendar failure finding in s_72a13bc3.

groups.defect: Authorization requires both admin and owner roles instead of either, permits overly broad attendee access, and uses a reportedly missing translation key for permission failures.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same incorrect conjunction. s_cc6b5fef additionally reports attendee authorization scope, while s_bd0c0912 additionally reports the missing translation; both extras must survive consolidation.
